fields.description: Baystar by Vida is a branded apartment development on the promenade at Rashid Yachts & Marina. One to four bedroom homes combine full-height glazing and outdoor spaces with a shared landscape above the waterfront. The proposed facilities include an infinity pool, gyms, gardens and spaces for children and residents to gather.

overview: Vida branding is expressed through the proposed interior palette: textured walls, wood screens, bronze details and earthy colours. The full brochure connects the residential amenities with the marina promenade, while a landscaped level introduces shaded places and barbecue areas above the waterfront. The homes vary significantly in outdoor space, particularly ground and podium layouts. A branded residence should still be assessed through its actual specification and operating arrangements; hotel-style services, membership and fees are not established by the brand name alone.
research.locationNote: Baystar is positioned along the marina promenade within Mina Rashid. The brochure map relates it to the QE2 hotel, canal pool and the wider waterfront masterplan. Heritage districts, Downtown and the airport form part of the wider location context; advertised driving times are traffic-dependent, and views vary by tower and unit.
research.priceNote: The developer page lists AED 2,105,888. The launch fact sheet gives starting prices of AED 2.1m, AED 3.2m, AED 4.9m and AED 11.3m for one, two, three and four bedrooms respectively. These reference figures do not confirm present availability or the price of a particular home.
research.paymentNote: The branded launch sheet records 10% booking, seven 10% instalments and 20% on estimated completion. Property Finder also displays an alternative 20/60/20 plan. Confirm which written offer applies to the selected home and any already-due amounts; the historic dates below are not a newly issued offer.
research.handoverNote: December 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month on the payment sheet and is also listed by Property Finder. Contractual delivery and current construction progress require confirmation.

facts.label: Published residential mix
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 319 homes: 177 in Tower 1 and 142 in Tower 2. Across both towers, the bedroom mix is 147 one bedroom, 100 two bedroom, 62 three bedroom and ten four bedroom homes. This is the launch mix, not available inventory.

facts.label: Comparing indoor and outdoor space
facts.value: Tower 1 two-bedroom Type A2 totals 1,921.15 sq ft, including an 836.36 sq ft terrace. Tower 2 four-bedroom Type B1 totals 2,899.80 sq ft: 2,568.59 sq ft suite plus 331.21 sq ft balconies. Its plan includes a separate maid’s room and laundry.
